description: This PHP source file defines the class OX_Admin_UI_Install_Wizard, which manages the installation and upgrade steps for the Revive Adserver's admin UI. It constructs the wizard steps based on installation status and storage properties, supporting recovery, installation, upgrade, and up-to-date states.

classes.name: OX_Admin_UI_Install_Wizard
classes.description: A class that manages the installation and upgrade wizard steps for the admin UI, dynamically building step sequences based on installation status and storage visibility flags.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the wizard with steps and metadata based on installation status and current step.

methods.name: initSteps
methods.description: Builds the array of steps and metadata for the wizard depending on whether the system is recovering, installing, upgrading, or up-to-date, and adjusts steps visibility based on storage flags.
